title: Goa
tagline: Sun, sand and a slower kind of time
description: Goa is two holidays in one. The north hums with beach shacks, sundowners and night markets; the south slows right down to empty coves, fishing villages and palm-shaded resorts where the only schedule is the tide.

Step inland and you'll find another Goa altogether — whitewashed baroque churches in Old Goa, the ochre-and-indigo lanes of Fontainhas, spice plantations and the thundering Dudhsagar Falls. Our itineraries mix the two so you leave both rested and inspired.
